Added Align Sleep: Feature that allows the user to set a sleep schedule so that Align can better schedule to the users patterns. Also added Smart Align, this is a third option that align prompts the user with when a time conflict arises, when chosen, align will take all other tasks and the sleep schedule into acount and will move the conflicting task to the first available slot of time where it fits. The user is still able to override/cancel if they desire.
